summary: ApiKeyControllerIT covers all six TDD anchors plus three extra anti-enumeration branches (missing/malformed/soft-deleted). Correct test type (IT with real Mongo + real security chain via MockMvc). Assertions are behavior-focused and meaningful (hash=SHA256(plaintext), old hash no longer resolves on regenerate, exactly one row, GET body asserted free of plaintext). No redundancy, no gaps.

findings.finding: Unauthenticated test asserts 403, not the 401 named in the task's TDD anchor.
findings.reason: 403 is the verified project-wide convention for anonymous on authenticated() /api/** routes (ProjectControllerIT.anyEndpoint_unauthenticated_returns403). The task's 401 was an assumption inconsistent with the session chain's AuthorizationFilter behavior. Documented in a test comment and in decisions.md Deviations.

findings.finding: Regenerate test asserts the OLD hash no longer resolves (findByKeyHash empty) and exactly one row exists, beyond just 'second plaintext != first'.
findings.reason: Strong invalidation/overwrite assertion — exactly what the AC requires.
